summary: Multiband compressor and upward expander for mastering and buses: 3 or 4 bands split by linear-phase crossovers (the bands sum back to the input exactly; about 96 ms of latency, reported to NeoBuzz Live) or zero-latency minimum-phase ones (Linkwitz–Riley, the same band shapes), each band with threshold, ratio (above 1:1 compresses, below 1:1 expands upward), attack, release, knee, range, makeup, solo and bypass; the detector (peak or RMS) linked in stereo or in mid/side; per band upward compression below the threshold and an external sidechain (input 2); lookahead; a Dynamic phase mode (zero latency, the input as the dry); mix and output. With every band at 1:1 and 0 dB it passes the input, delayed by the latency, bit for bit. Use it to control the lows, tame harshness, de-ess, glue a bus or lift the air of a master.
use_for: Control one frequency band at a time on buses and masters, compressing or expanding upwards.

parameters.name: Bands
parameters.description: Three bands (Crossover 1 and 2) or four (all three crossovers)
parameters.how: Chooses three or four bands for the dynamics.
parameters.sound: Four bands give finer control over the top end; three keep things simpler.

parameters.name: Crossover 1
parameters.description: Between bands 1 and 2 (Linkwitz–Riley, 24 dB/oct, −6 dB here)
parameters.how: Sets the frequency between bands 1 and 2, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz.
parameters.sound: It decides how much of the low end belongs to the lowest band.

parameters.name: Crossover 2
parameters.description: Between bands 2 and 3 (never below Crossover 1)
parameters.how: Sets the frequency between bands 2 and 3.
parameters.sound: It moves the boundary between the lower and upper midrange.

parameters.name: Crossover 3
parameters.description: Between bands 3 and 4 with four bands (never below Crossover 2)
parameters.how: Sets the frequency between bands 3 and 4 when four bands are used.
parameters.sound: It decides where the top band begins.

parameters.name: Phase
parameters.description: Linear: the bands sum back to the input exactly, no phase shift, about 96 ms of latency (reported to NeoBuzz Live). Minimum: zero latency, the same band shapes, the crossovers' phase shift (as an analog crossover's). Dynamic: zero latency and no static phase shift: the output is the input plus each band's gain change times the band, so a band at 0 dB change leaves the input exactly as it was (the crossovers' phase shift shows only where a band is changing)
parameters.how: Chooses Linear (about 96 ms latency, no phase shift), Minimum (no latency, crossover phase shift) or Dynamic (no latency, phase shift only where a band changes).
parameters.sound: Linear and Dynamic keep the untouched sound exactly as it was, which suits mastering; Minimum suits live use where latency matters.

parameters.name: Stereo
parameters.description: What each band's detector and gain work on: left and right, or mid and side
parameters.how: Chooses whether the bands work on left and right, or on mid and side.
parameters.sound: Mid/side lets the centre and the width be compressed separately.

parameters.name: Link
parameters.description: 100 %: both channels (or mid and side) get the same gain, from the louder; 0 %: each its own
parameters.how: Sets how much both channels share the same gain, from 0 % to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Linked keeps the stereo image steady; unlinked lets each side react on its own.

parameters.name: B1 threshold
parameters.description: Band 1: level where the gain starts to change (the band's peak)
parameters.how: Sets the level, from -60 to 0 dB, at which band 1's gain starts to change.
parameters.sound: Lower values act on more of the band and make it denser and more even.

parameters.name: B1 ratio
parameters.description: Band 1: above 1:1 compresses above the threshold (∞: limits); below 1:1 expands upward (0.5:1 doubles the level over the threshold); 1:1 does nothing
parameters.how: Sets band 1's ratio: above 1:1 it compresses, below 1:1 it expands, and 1:1 does nothing.
parameters.sound: Higher ratios squeeze the band harder; ratios under 1:1 make loud parts louder.

parameters.name: B1 attack
parameters.description: Band 1: time to 63 % of a gain change
parameters.how: Sets how fast band 1's gain reacts, from 0.05 ms to 200 ms.
parameters.sound: Fast attacks tame the start of hits; slow ones let them through for more punch.

parameters.name: B1 release
parameters.description: Band 1: time back to 37 % of a gain change
parameters.how: Sets how fast band 1's gain returns, from 5 ms to 3 s.
parameters.sound: Short releases sound lively and can pump; long ones sound smooth.

parameters.name: B1 knee
parameters.description: Band 1: width of the soft knee around the threshold
parameters.how: Sets how gradually band 1's dynamics start around the threshold, from 0 to 24 dB.
parameters.sound: Wider knees are smoother and less noticeable.

parameters.name: B1 range
parameters.description: Band 1: the most the gain changes, either way
parameters.how: Limits how far band 1's gain can change either way, from 0 to 24 dB.
parameters.sound: A small range keeps the effect gentle; a large one allows strong action.

parameters.name: B1 makeup
parameters.description: Band 1: gain after the dynamics (negative cuts the band)
parameters.how: Adds or removes up to 24 dB of gain on band 1 after the dynamics.
parameters.sound: Positive values lift the band; negative values cut it, changing the tonal balance.

parameters.name: B1 solo
parameters.description: Band 1: hear only the soloed bands (processed, Mix ignored)
parameters.how: Plays only the soloed bands, processed, ignoring Mix.
parameters.sound: You hear band 1 by itself, which helps you set its dynamics.

parameters.name: B1 bypass
parameters.description: Band 1: pass the band untouched (no dynamics, no makeup)
parameters.how: Passes band 1 untouched, with no dynamics and no makeup.
parameters.sound: Band 1 sounds as it came in, so you can compare with and without it.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry against the processed bands (the dry is latency-aligned, so parallel compression never combs)
parameters.how: Blends the dry signal with the processed bands.
parameters.sound: Lower values add the dynamics as a parallel layer, keeping punch and detail.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Output gain, −24 … +24 dB in 0.1 dB steps
parameters.how: Sets the output gain, from -24 to +24 dB.
parameters.sound: It makes the whole sound louder or quieter without changing the tone.

parameters.name: Detector
parameters.description: What every band's detector reads: the peak, or the RMS (3 ms mean square, on the peak scale: a sine reads the same as with Peak)
parameters.how: Chooses whether every band's detector reads the peak or the RMS level.
parameters.sound: Peak reacts quickly to hits; RMS is smoother and follows loudness more closely.

parameters.name: Lookahead
parameters.description: Delays the bands (and the dry) so each detector sees what is coming; adds this much latency to the phase's own, reported to NeoBuzz Live. A change fades the sound out and in over 10 ms each
parameters.how: Delays the bands by up to 10 ms so each detector sees what is coming.
parameters.sound: Fast peaks are caught cleanly, at the cost of extra latency.

parameters.name: B1 upward ratio
parameters.description: Band 1: below the threshold the band is raised by (threshold - level) x (1 - 1/ratio), within Range, on the same knee and times (1:1 off; nothing is raised under -80 dBFS)
parameters.how: Raises band 1 when it falls below its threshold, up to 8:1 (1:1 is off).
parameters.sound: Quiet detail and tails in the band come up, giving a fuller, more even sound.

parameters.name: B1 sidechain
parameters.description: Band 1: its detector hears the band's own signal, or input 2 through the same crossovers (connect a machine to the second input; none connected: it hears silence)
parameters.how: Chooses whether band 1's detector hears its own signal or the machine on the second input.
parameters.sound: External lets another sound, such as a kick, duck or lift this band.

parameters.name: B2 upward ratio
parameters.description: Band 2: below the threshold the band is raised by (threshold - level) x (1 - 1/ratio), within Range, on the same knee and times (1:1 off; nothing is raised under -80 dBFS)
